title: K-FIELD: CUMULATIVE HYSTERESIS ON THE CLOSED EARTH-CMB ROUTE
subtitle: Forward and Reverse Circulation Through an Asymmetric Scalar Cost Field

authoritative_source_route_snapshot.title: Maximum residual closed Earth-CMB route in the authoritative ICRS quadratic phase metric

assumptions.route_class: single-pass closed loops formed by two distinct Earth-forced meridian semicircles

authoritative_source_route_snapshot.cost_functional: C[gamma] = integral_gamma sqrt(n^T G_phase n) ds

optimization_parameterization.b_theta: b(theta)=cos(theta)e1+sin(theta)e2, with e1,e2 orthonormal and perpendicular to c_hat

closed_lune.equivalent_branch_degeneracy: Each optimized plane has two antipodally related semicircular branches with equal integrated cost.

earth_force_work.required_asymmetry: Fund the high-cost leg while suppressing, reversing, or otherwise changing Earth coupling on the low-cost return.

coordinate_conventions.route_arc_length_unit: R, equal to radians when R=1
coordinate_conventions.cell3_unit: native Cell3 unit; not identified with the route sphere radius
coordinate_conventions.scale_separation: Cell3 and the route share the ICRS orientation frame but remain separate scale domains.

closed_route.construction: two trimmed great-circle meridians plus symmetric sinusoidal-curvature tangent-plane bridges mapped by the unit-sphere exponential map
closed_route.continuity: C3 endpoint continuity: position, tangent, curvature/force, and jerk are continuous; geodesic curvature and its arc-length derivative are zero at every interface

closed_lune.equivalent_branch_degeneracy: Each optimized plane has two antipodally related semicircular branches with equal integrated cost.

cumulative_hysteresis.reverse_equal_distance_definition: C_R(s)=integral_0^s q_F((-u) mod L) du = C_loop-C_F(L-s)
cumulative_hysteresis.same_location_definition: reverse cost from the common start to physical point r(s) is C_loop-C_F(s)

dimensional_scaling.normalized_R_equals_1: q, C, s, and loop area are numerical normalized quantities.
dimensional_scaling.physical_radius_R_phys: distance scales as R_phys; cumulative cost scales as R_phys; hysteresis area scales as R_phys^2.
dimensional_scaling.series_turn_count_N_turns: closed-loop cost and cumulative separation scale linearly with N_turns for identical series turns; the area over total series distance scales as N_turns^2 if the same single-turn coordinate is concatenated N_turns times.

central_findings: The forward and reverse completed-loop scalar costs are equal.
The cumulative scalar histories do not retrace at equal distance traveled.
The maximum cumulative separation is reached at half the loop and equals 2.748220082602275 normalized cost units.
The signed area between cumulative traces is 7.596421328301542 normalized cost-distance units.
The local scalar density is memoryless, while its accumulated state is path-order dependent; this is geometric cumulative hysteresis.
